subject: Very large map distance between markers

messages.author: 37ffc8fdaa4a5001
messages.subject: Very large map distance between markers
parts:
Hello,

I have a number of pairs of markers where est.map() is producing extremely large marker spacing (800-1000cM between "adjacent" markers).  I am working on whether or not the order is correct but regardless, why would the estimated distances be so large?  (in one case I looked at the rf and it was ~.45).  

This is an F2 cross and I am using default settings for est.map().

Any thoughts?

Thanks,

J.

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Very large map distance between markers
parts:
We estimate the recombination fractions between markers and then convert them to centiMorgans with a map function, and so if the spacing is large it must be that the estimated recombination fraction is close to 0.5.

The estimated recombination fractions are not the same as what you'd get from looking at pairs of markers in isolation, as from est.rf(). The est.map() function uses the full data of markers along a chromosome ("multipoint").

karl
